adapter.description: Runtime adapter label stamped into snapshots and raw rows, for example ollama or llama_cpp.

aiopslab_task.description: AIOpsLab-inspired lifecycle/task mapping for the scenario.

bracket.description: Legacy footprint bracket from older rosters; current thesis tiering uses model_lock.* fields.

class.description: Scenario taxonomy class such as detect, diagnose, guard, test, expand, or upgrade.

class_counts.description: Run metadata count of scenarios by class.

difficulty_counts.description: Run metadata count of scenarios by difficulty.

dnf.description: Did-not-finish flag. True rows are reliability failures, not missing data.

evidence.description: Judge explanation/evidence for the score and verdict.

expect.description: Number of models the consumer expects to fully persist for this run.

finish_reason.description: Legacy/simple finish reason when gen_ai.response.finish_reasons is unavailable.

gen_ai.completion.description: Verbatim model answer retained for re-judging, transcript inspection, and distillation exports.

grounding.description: Whether the scenario answer is derivable from supplied context or requires closed-book knowledge.

grounding_counts.description: Run metadata count of scenarios by grounding label.

judges.description: Expected number of judges per inference row.

max_tokens_cap.description: Run-level max-token cap override, usually present only for smoke runs.

model.description: Model deployment identifier requested for this row.

model_set.description: Run matrix model-set id selected for the run.

pair_id.description: Identifier for paired scenario variants when present.

samples.description: Per-request sampler time series; see samples[] field catalog.

score.description: Judge ordinal score for the answer.

started_at.description: Unix timestamp when run metadata was created.

sync_mode.description: Producer source sync mode, for example origin or working-tree.

temp.description: Sampling temperature used for this row.

timeout_policy_id.description: Timeout policy id used by the runner.

ts.description: Unix timestamp when the row was written.

usage.description: Judge backend usage object when available; null for Copilot CLI judge rows that do not report token usage.

user.description: Dashboard/auth user label that launched the run.

verdict.description: Judge natural-language verdict for the answer.

wall_s.description: End-to-end row wall-clock duration in seconds.

prefix.description: Judge criteria list for met or missed requirements.
